frontmatter.name: chat-worker-test-infra-gap
frontmatter.description: @app/chat-worker has no vitest/Vitest setup; BullMQ processors untested. Deferred as separate infra PR. Known gap, documented in SCRUM-64 spec as out-of-scope.

memory_entries_to_create.body:

name: chat-worker-test-infra-gap
description: "@app/chat-worker has no vitest/Vitest setup; BullMQ processors untested. Deferred as separate infra PR."
metadata:
  type: debt
  originSessionId: SCRUM-64
  priority: medium
---

**Status:** Known gap, documented in SCRUM-64 spec (deferred out-of-scope).

**Why it exists:** `@app/chat-worker` is a BullMQ consumer with 4 processors:
- `auto-close-processor` (closes stale conversations hourly)
- `send-processor` (broadcasts messages)
- `incoming-processor` (handles inbound messages)
- `ai-bot-stub` (AI response placeholder)

Each processor is a function: `(job: Job) => Promise<void>`. Testing requires:

1. BullMQ mock/test adapter (not in package.json)
2. MongoDB in-memory server (mongodb-memory-server) for @repo/db-chat models
3. Socket.IO event mocks for pubsubClient
4. Vitest + node environment (jsdom not needed)

**Why deferred:** Adding vitest to chat-worker is ~30-60 min of infra setup (tsconfig, vitest.config.ts, test utils, first test proof-of-concept). Out of scope for individual processor bug fixes. Related packages (@repo/db-chat, packages/core) already have vitest + coverage.

**How to apply:** When planning test coverage for chat-worker processors, create separate infra PR:

1. Add devDependencies: `vitest`, `@vitest/ui`, `mongodb-memory-server`, `@types/bullmq`
2. Create `vitest.config.ts` (node env, MongoDB setup, BullMQ mock factory)
3. Write 1-2 integration tests as proof-of-concept (test auto-close with mock conversations)
4. Update root `pnpm test` to include chat-worker

**Signals to watch:** Future PRs touching chat-worker processors will note TDD not applicable or no test coverage available. If next audit/work item encounters this, check if vitest infra was added meanwhile — it might be resolved.

**Related:** SCRUM-64 (auto-close processor), possibly SCRUM-63/SCRUM-65 (other chat-worker fixes in same audit batch).

frontmatter.name: backend-bug-fix-inline-exception
frontmatter.description: Backend bug fix (<50 LOC, no feature logic, no behavior change) can run inline in Phase 5, not requiring subagent dispatch. Refines memory feedback_refactor-inline-vs-subagent-dispatch with explicit backend exception.

memory_entries_to_create.body:
---
name: backend-bug-fix-inline-exception
description: "Backend bug fix (<50 LOC, no feature logic) can run inline in Phase 5, not subagent. Refines feedback_refactor-inline-vs-subagent-dispatch."
metadata:
  type: feedback
  originSessionId: SCRUM-64
  relatedMemory: feedback_refactor-inline-vs-subagent-dispatch
---

Refined criterion for Phase 5 IMPLEMENT dispatch decision:

**Memory** `feedback_refactor-inline-vs-subagent-dispatch` says <200 LOC inline. **CLAUDE.md skill table** says Backend subagent. **Conflict resolved:** Table rule is for features (new state, behavior, tests). Bug fixes are exceptions.

**SCRUM-64 validates:** MongoDB index + batch limit fix (+7/-1 LOC, no behavior change, @app/chat-worker + @repo/db-chat) ran inline successfully, confirming LOC-based criterion is correct.

**How to apply — Heuristic before invoking subagent in Phase 5:**

| Work type | Scope | Criterion | Path |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bug fix** | Any backend (server, chat-server, worker, db) | <50 LOC, no behavior change, no new tests | **inline** (main session) |
| **Feature** | Backend (new use case, state, tests) | Any | **subagent** |
| **Refactor** | Frontend components | <200 LOC, no behavior change, pattern-based | **inline** |
| **Complex refactor** | Multi-system | >200 LOC or multi-app | **subagent** |

Example bug fixes that should run inline:
- Add index to MongoDB schema (SCRUM-64: +1 LOC)
- Fix constant placement / batch limit (SCRUM-64: +2 LOC)
- Update logger output (SCRUM-64: +4 LOC)
- Small query fix without data migration

Example features that need subagent:
- New API endpoint (requires tests, use case, handler, route)
- New DDD entity (repository, mapper, entity, tests)
- New worker processor (requires vitest setup if not exists)

**Note:** Bug fix inline still goes through full pipeline (lint, typecheck, build, test, code review, CI). Difference is context (main session vs subagent context handoff), not rigor.
